issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires Farm.animals to be a List implemented using an ArrayList and initialized in the no-argument constructor, but the provided solution implements animals as a Queue backed by a LinkedList. This contradicts the specification and may confuse students (and tests) that expect a List/ArrayList.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the problem statement: declare the field as List<Animal> animals and initialize it with new ArrayList<>() in the no-argument constructor. Update the getter and setter to use List<Animal> as well. This preserves the intended design and avoids confusion with Queue/LinkedList semantics.
